description: This file defines the ViewsPluginInterface interface for Drupal views plugins, specifying methods for plugin management, form handling, token processing, and plugin initialization.

methods.name: pluginTitle
methods.description: Returns the human readable name of the display.

methods.name: filterByDefinedOptions
methods.description: Filter out stored options depending on the defined options.

methods.name: summaryTitle
methods.description: Returns the summary of the settings in the display.

methods.name: preRenderAddFieldsetMarkup
methods.description: Moves form elements into fieldsets for presentation purposes.

methods.name: submitOptionsForm
methods.description: Handle any special handling on the validate form.

methods.name: globalTokenForm
methods.description: Adds elements for available core tokens to a form.

methods.name: getAvailableGlobalTokens
methods.description: Returns an array of available token replacements.

methods.name: preRenderFlattenData
methods.description: Flattens the structure of form elements.

methods.name: globalTokenReplace
methods.description: Returns a string with any core tokens replaced.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validate that the plugin is correct and can be saved.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Add anything to the query that we might need to.

methods.name: unpackOptions
methods.description: Unpacks options over our existing defaults.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Provide a form to edit options for this plugin.

methods.name: themeFunctions
methods.description: Provide a full list of possible theme templates used by this style.
